_doc: GX2 room dressing (docs/interiors.md section 6, src/interior.cpp Planner). Read once at start-up; every random pick is seeded by the building's furnishing seed and the slot name, so a building dresses the same on every machine. Per room type: steps (the furniture recipe, run in order), zones (cluster groupings placed in each 4-5 m zone of an oversized room), centerZones (free-standing groupings in the middle of every other zone at least 5 m wide), centerFloor (rooms at least subdivide.centerMin m across: a cluster sized to each centerCell m cell down the middle of the floor, centerBand m clear of the walls each side, cycling through the list from a seeded start; replaces centerZones there), wall (wall-mounted items: target count per metre of wall, the longest bare wall allowed, the items, floor pieces used where nothing can hang), rug / curtains / halfDrawn / debris chances. Step fields: do = wall (a floor piece backed onto a wall) | hang (a wall-mounted piece at its mount height) | center (free-standing, kept off the walls by ring m; or area = [x0, z0, x1, z1], the whole group in the anchor frame, which needs its floor free and a 0.9 m walkway round it) | rug | rows (pews, school desks toward the far end) | farEnd (an altar or teacher's desk at the far end) | cluster (a named cluster from 'clusters'); assets = fallbacks tried in order, 'a|b' = one of them picked by seed; p = chance (x the building's density unless fixed); sure = hearth | noHearth: the step always runs in that case; if = {minArea, maxArea, hearth}; n = [base, per density] count; top = {from, n, clutter: n grows with clutter}: small pieces on the placed piece's top; chairs = [{assets, n: [base, per density], ends}] round a table; satellites = [{assets, at: [x, y, z] in the anchor's frame (+z is its front), turn deg, alt: a second spot, p, rug, top, jitter: [m, deg]}]; papers = {p, n} (x clutter); broken = chance it is left broken; corner > 0 prefers corners, < 0 mid-wall.
